title: 🚀 Introducing ANAT — AI Network Anomaly Tracker
description: ANAT (AI Network Anomaly Tracker) is an open-source, lightweight Intrusion Detection System (IDS) designed for real-time network traffic monitoring and anomaly detection. It captures packets, detects suspicious activities such as port scans, floods, and large packets, and visualizes alerts through a cyberpunk-themed dashboard. The tool supports alert logging, filtering, trusted source suppression, and integration with Discord for alert notifications. It is intended for educational and authorized security testing purposes only and requires elevated privileges for packet capture.
